hero.description: Today, WIDATRA is the largest manufacturer of basic intravenous solution products and a market leader in Indonesia — poised to become the biggest intravenous solution company in Southeast Asia.

intro.p1: PT Widatra Bhakti is a pharmaceutical company and a member of the Otsuka Group in Indonesia. We strive relentlessly to contribute to public health by producing high-quality products at competitive prices, playing a strategic role in Indonesia's National Health System.
intro.p2: Our Pandaan campus is surrounded by a green environment, providing a pleasant and healthy working atmosphere for the people who keep Indonesia's hospitals supplied — every day.
intro.quote: Quality is vital in the factory, and so is packaging — we manufacture and market by putting ourselves in the consumer's position.

manufacturing.description: We combine Japanese engineering with Indonesian craftsmanship to produce life-saving IV solutions that meet international pharmacopeia standards — from raw water to final pallet.

hero.description: Widatra Bhakti has been engineering Indonesia's most trusted sterile infusion solutions since 1986 — a story written one validated batch at a time.

profile.p1: PT Widatra Bhakti was licensed to manufacture basic intravenous solution products in 1986 under a manufacturing license and technical guidance from a leading German company, based in Pandaan, East Java.
profile.p2: In 1995, Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., Japan acquired PT Widatra Bhakti. Today WIDATRA is the largest manufacturer of basic intravenous solution products and a market leader in Indonesia, supplying hospitals and health institutions across the country.

visionMission.visionText: To become a leading pharmaceutical company in Indonesia and play an important role in the Asian region.
missionItems: Contribute relentlessly to public health by producing high-quality products at competitive prices.
Play a strategic role in Indonesia's National Health System as a reliable partner for better health.
Uphold the 5+1S pillars — Speed, Synergy, Share, Simplify, Smart and Sincere — in everything we do.
Develop our people as our most valuable asset, with good attitude, knowledge, skill and experience.
